chunks: My father (RA) said: Sa'd ibn Abd Allah, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Hamran, from Abu Abdillah (AS), said:

Whoever says: 'There is no god but Allah,' sincerely, will enter Paradise. And his sincerity is that the profession 'There is no god but Allah' refrains him from whatever Allah, the Mighty and High, has forbidden.

key_terms.إخلاص: Sincerity, purity of intention and practice
key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: There is no god but Allah (the core creed)

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of sincerity (Ikhlas) in the declaration of 'La ilaha illa Allah' according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq uses this narration to define the practical essence of Ikhlas as a transformative force that actively restrains the believer from divine prohibitions, linking creed directly to conduct. This aligns with the Shia emphasis on the unity of knowledge and action, where true monotheism manifests in adherence to Sharia boundaries. The hadith thus serves as a criterion for authentic faith, moving beyond mere verbal declaration to embodied spiritual discipline.
